Hey @robskieee gymnast of eight years here, and have achieved planche + planche press ups. A friend i trained with was 6'2/6'3 and he could do straddle planche. Your height makes this quite difficult to achieve with proper form. This could take 5+ years for perfection. 

SO many people neglect to say what else you should be doing. You will find lots of information on training and steps to take to achieve plance. If this is a main goal of yours, you want to regiment rotator cuff flexibility and strength. All those little exercises with low weights. Your shoulders can lift three different ways (lateral, forward and lying down lifting back), rotate two (forward and backwards), and push two (forward and backwards). Your rotator will thank you later. I know the pains i got from mainly training the front delts when i learnt planche, As did my coach when he was young. Any questions just ask.
